label.explanation: The geo-IP provider (api.geoip.example) began returning 5xx and timing out (lines 233, 236, 238, 243); enrichment-svc's circuit breaker opened (line 246) and its probes keep failing (lines 276, 309). Nothing on our side changed. ingest-api's errors (lines 247, 266, 277, 292, 314, 315) and the ingest-gateway 503s (lines 240, 249, 252, 264, 272, 275, 287, 293, 295, 310, 319, 325) are symptoms. Fail over or degrade gracefully until the provider recovers. Some calls time out rather than error, so dependency_timeout is defensible, but the provider is returning hard 5xx errors: it is down. Red herrings: line 39 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); line 213 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 218 (a single API client being rate-limited, which is the limiter working as intended); line 239 (a config reload that changed nothing).
